title: Practice [Structs + Stack Frames]
description:
## Putting It All Together
Time to combine everything: structs, stack frames, calling convention, and functions.


---
## Assignment:
LHINX needs a process manager. You're given a process struct with `pid` (4 bytes), `priority` (4 bytes), and `memory` (4 bytes).

Write a function `boost_process` that:
1. Takes a pointer to a process struct in `rdi` and a boost amount in `rsi`
2. Uses a proper stack frame (prologue/epilogue)
3. Stores the original priority in a local stack variable
4. Adds `rsi` to the process's priority field (modify the struct in memory)
5. Returns the OLD priority in `rax`
setupCode:
section .data
    pass_msg db "PASS", 10
    pass_len equ $ - pass_msg
    fail_msg db "FAIL", 10
    fail_len equ $ - fail_msg
    proc1:
        dd 1
        dd 5
        dd 512

section .text
    global _start
starterCode:
boost_process:
    ; prologue
    ; save old priority to local var
    ; add boost to priority in struct
    ; return old priority
    ; epilogue
    ret
runHarness:
_start:
    lea rdi, [proc1]
    mov rsi, 3
    call boost_process
    cmp rax, 5
    jne .fail
    mov eax, [proc1 + 4]
    cmp eax, 8
    jne .fail
    lea rdi, [proc1]
    mov rsi, 2
    call boost_process
    cmp rax, 8
    jne .fail
    mov eax, [proc1 + 4]
    cmp eax, 10
    jne .fail
    mov rax, 1
    mov rdi, 1
    mov rsi, pass_msg
    mov rdx, pass_len
    syscall
    jmp .exit
.fail:
    mov rax, 1
    mov rdi, 1
    mov rsi, fail_msg
    mov rdx, fail_len
    syscall
.exit:
    mov rax, 60
    xor rdi, rdi
    syscall
hint: Priority is at [rdi + 4]. Save it to [rbp - 4] before modifying. Add esi to [rdi + 4] directly. Return the saved value.
